reason: I'd try one Saturday drop-in for $12 since it's a rainy-day option and I'm not paying for a membership I'd only use 3 or 4 times. Whether I go back depends on how clean it looks when I walk in.
objection: Is it actually clean? My toddler puts everything in her mouth, and a bunch of kids touching the same toys all day worries me. It says nothing about how they clean.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing or being told how toys get cleaned and swapped out during the day, like a posted cleaning schedule or a toy sanitizing routine, plus shoes-off. A free or cheap first visit would also get me in the door.
